units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 65a:9">B. Mets. 65ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ש׳ אינה משתלמת וכ׳</he> rent (for a house or a field) is not due before the end of the term.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 98a:8">Ib. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>פלגיה דיומא בשאילה … בש׳</he> (I let thee have the two cows) half a day as a loan, and half a day for hire.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 98a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>ודקיימא דש׳ היא</he> and the cow that survived is the hired one.
